race.name: Lexus Melbourne Cup 2026
race.expected_track: Soft 5-6 (5-10mm forecast Monday, clearing Tuesday; rail +3m)
race.pace_outlook: No clear leader. Enfjaar, So You Are, Royal Supremacy, Wine Dark Sea, Kizlyar are the go-forward types; several are drawn wide so an honest early tempo is expected.
race.odds_snapshot: Consensus of TAB / Ladbrokes / CrownBet fixed prices published 31 Oct - 2 Nov 2026

_field_notes: Final field after Defiantly (vet), Saint George and Stinger Glass were withdrawn; Kizlyar and Future History gained starts.
leadups are most-recent first. tempo codes: SLOW, MODERATE, FAST, UNKNOWN. Racelab reported only 11 of 24 runners had a moderate-or-faster lead-up:
that matches rating the Caulfield Cup and Geelong Cup as MODERATE, the Ebor as FAST, and the Cox Plate / Moonee Valley Cup / Bendigo Cup / Tesio / Kilternan / Irish St Leger / Crystal Mile as SLOW.
excuses are free-text tags the form engine recognises: FIRST_UP, WIDE, HEAVY_TRACK, INTERFERENCE, DROPPED_WHIP, OVERRACED, SHORT_SHARPENER, BIG_WEIGHT, WIDE_BARRIER, EASED, FELL.
wet_rating: +1 proven on rain-affected ground, 0 unknown/neutral, -1 connections want firm ground.
settle: predicted settling position 1-24 (speed map). wet_record: starts/wins/seconds/thirds on rain-affected ground where published (null = not found).
gear: reported gear changes (Robopunter 31 Oct listed unconfirmed 'cap' changes for Juja Kibo, Royal Supremacy, Goodie Two Shoes, James J Braddock; nothing else found).
jockey_cup_wins: Melbourne Cup wins by the booked rider (McDonald 2021, Zahra 2022-23, Williams 2019, Melham 2025, Dolan 2024, McNeil 2020).
golden_ticket: campaign built around a ballot-exempt race. campaign: one-line description of how THIS horse was handled, used to blend with the trainer's general method.

silks: {body, sleeves, cap, pattern} CSS colours for the racebook page; status 'confirmed' (published description), 'approx' (owner's known colours, exact design unverified) or 'tbc' (not found - drawn grey). Edit here to correct.
last4: last four starts oldest -> newest as printed in the racebook; entries with approx=true have the finishing position from a published form string but the race label is inferred.

runners.notes: Topweight. Dual G2 winner (Red Sea Turf Hcp 3000m, Maurice de Nieuil 2800m). Beat stablemates James J Braddock and Goodie Two Shoes in the Kilternan. Handles all ground, rarely runs poorly, but 57.5kg is the heaviest winning weight since Makybe Diva's 58kg.
runners.campaign: Classic O'Brien fly-in: European summer campaign (Riyadh, Dubai, Ascot, Longchamp), Kilternan 2nd in September, straight to Werribee, no Australian run.
runners.verdict: Topweight fly-in from the Twilight Payment stable; handles any ground. 57.5kg is the catch.

silks.desc: White, pink star, white cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Same Irish St Leger -> Cup route Joseph O'Brien used with Twilight Payment (2020), but this horse is a hold-up closer not a leader, carries 57kg from barrier 18, and the trainer has said he wants dry, fast ground. J McDonald rides.
runners.campaign: Classic O'Brien fly-in via the Curragh Cup (won, like Rekindling and Twilight Payment) and Irish St Leger 4th, 51 days fresh, no Australian run. Hold-up closer, unlike Twilight Payment.
runners.verdict: Curragh Cup winner on the exact O'Brien route, but a hold-up closer wanting firm ground, 57kg, gate 18.

silks.desc: Emerald green, gold hoops, hooped sleeves, white cap (J P McManus)
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: 2024 Cup winner at $91 off a 16th-14th-5th lead-up line; this year's Herbert Power third was rated better than anything in that winning prep. Carries 5kg more than 2024 and the incident-packed Caulfield Cup can be forgiven. Missed 2025 spring (strangles outbreak).
runners.campaign: Same Symons/Laxon shape as 2024: Queensland winter, four Victorian runs rising in distance (Naturalism, Herbert Power 3rd, Caulfield Cup), ridden from the back; 5kg more than 2024.
runners.verdict: 2024 winner, same four-run build; Herbert Power third was good, 5kg more than 2024.

silks.desc: Magenta, black star, yellow sleeves with black stars, yellow cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Third in the 2025 Cup. Five unplaced runs this prep in much tougher weight-for-age company (Underwood, Caulfield Cup, Cox Plate) - the classic Maher Gold Trip route (Caulfield Cup -> Cox Plate -> Cup, 2022). Third-fastest last 200m in the Caulfield Cup, settled last in the Cox Plate. Barrier 1, Zahra.
runners.campaign: Maher Gold Trip route: five weight-for-age / Caulfield Cup runs (Underwood, Caulfield Cup, Cox Plate) as sharpeners, raced hard, ridden last.
runners.verdict: Third last year; Gold Trip route through Caulfield Cup and Cox Plate, gate 1, Zahra. Needs the swoopers' race.

silks.desc: Royal blue, yellow stars, blue and white checked sleeves, checked cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Sixth in the 2025 Cup (his best of three attempts). One run since May, 60.5kg from a wide gate at Geelong. Nine-year-old; no horse that old has won since 1941.
runners.campaign: Unusually light Waterhouse/Bott campaign: one run since May (Geelong Cup under 60.5kg), 13 days fresh, forward type.
runners.verdict: Nine-year-old, one run since May under 60.5kg, gate 22. Past it for this.

silks.desc: Royal blue, white horseshoe, black and white checked sleeves and cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Raced on speed first-up after three months and only 'felt the pinch' in the last 100m of the Caulfield Cup (rider thought he would win on the turn). Led all the way in the Glorious Stakes. Caulfield Cup top-3 is the single most productive Cup lead-up. Tough, handles all ground, untried at 3200m. Passed the vet on his second inspection.
runners.campaign: European base (Glorious Stakes win leading), quarantine at Werribee, one Australian run first-up in the Caulfield Cup (3rd on speed), 17 days to the Cup - the Protectionist / Delta Blues fly-in-with-one-run shape.
runners.verdict: On-speed Caulfield Cup third first-up, handles all ground. The classic Delta Blues / Protectionist one-run import.

silks.desc: Purple, green stars, green sleeves, green and purple cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Led throughout to win the JRA Cup, then sent forward and eased out of the Caulfield Cup. 15th in the 2025 Cup. Barrier 21; outsider of the Maher seven.
runners.campaign: Maher race-hardened local: JRA Cup win leading, Caulfield Cup (eased), likely leader.
runners.verdict: Likely leader, eased out of the Caulfield Cup, gate 21. Pace influence more than a chance.

silks.desc: Royal blue, white horseshoe, black and white checked sleeves, black cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Won 3 of 4 in England this year including the Geoffrey Freer over Dubai Honour. Forced wide early on debut here, hit the front on the turn and weakened. Barrier 23; needs several lengths of improvement but has the excuse.
runners.campaign: English base (3 wins from 4), Werribee quarantine, one Australian run first-up in the Caulfield Cup ridden forward, 17 days to the Cup.
runners.verdict: Forgive the wide first-up Caulfield Cup run; English form strong, but gate 23 and untried at the trip.

silks.desc: Green, blue and yellow mandala design, green patterned cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Tattersall's Cup (2400m) winner in June; below par in the Turnbull and Caulfield Cup. Eight-year-old.
runners.campaign: Waller race-hardened local: Naturalism, Turnbull, Caulfield Cup, ridden from the back.
runners.verdict: Eight-year-old off two poor spring runs. Hard to make a case.

silks.desc: Green, red band, green and red cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Second in the 2025 Cup with 51.5kg; carries 3.5kg more and drew 19. Trainer says career-best and wants a fast track. Only three mares have placed since 2005.
runners.campaign: O'Brien repeat fly-in: Lillie Langtry win, Kilternan last, 52 days fresh, no Australian run; only four runs since last year's Cup second.
runners.verdict: Last year's runner-up, but 3.5kg more, gate 19, last in the Kilternan and wants a fast track.

silks.desc: Emerald green, gold hoops, hooped sleeves, green and gold cap (J P McManus)
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Golden Ticket via the MV Gold Cup, beating stablemates Kings Valley and Mr Monaco. Maher: 'came off a slow speed and showed such a good turn of foot'. Flies off moderate tempos; the question is whether he gets that at 3200m. Kingston Rule (1990) is the only MV Cup winner to go on and win.
runners.campaign: Maher Golden Ticket campaign: Metropolitan win then MV Gold Cup win ten days out (both slowly run), closer.
runners.verdict: Two slowly run wins including the MV Cup Golden Ticket; loves wet ground. Needs tempo to swoop at 3200m.

silks.desc: Royal blue, yellow stars, blue and white checked sleeves and cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Head second of 22 in a strongly run Ebor (jockey dropped the whip inside the final furlong); rated 109. Direct fly-in with no Australian run, 73 days between runs - the Cross Counter / Heartbreak City template. Handles rain-affected ground. Untried at 3200m.
runners.campaign: Boughey fly-in: Goodwood handicap win, Ebor 2nd, then 73 days fresh straight to the Cup from Werribee - the Cross Counter / Heartbreak City shape with no Australian run.
runners.verdict: Head second in a strongly run Ebor, 73 days fresh, Boughey's fly-in method mirrors O'Brien's. Rain helps.

silks.desc: Royal blue, cream sleeves, red cap (Wathnan Racing)
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: 2024 Geelong Cup and 2025 MV Gold Cup winner; 12th and 16th in his two Cups. Now trained locally. Last in the Herbert Power and 11th at Geelong.
runners.campaign: Now a settled local: Herbert Power (last) and Geelong Cup (11th), on-pace type.
runners.verdict: Two Cups, 12th and 16th; last in the Herbert Power. No.

silks.desc: Light blue, dark blue hollow square, light blue sleeves, light and dark blue cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Second in the Sydney Cup at his only 3200m start. Barrier 5 (equal most successful gate). Form this spring a notch below autumn.
runners.campaign: Waller race-hardened local: Metropolitan, Caulfield Cup; Sydney Cup 2nd in autumn.
runners.verdict: Sydney Cup second at the trip, gate 5, Waller race-hardening. Place hope at a price.

silks.desc: Navy, white band, white armbands, navy and white cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Second favourite in the Caulfield Cup, ran sixth. Heavy-track Turnbull forgiven. Light weight, good gate, untried at 3200m.
runners.campaign: Maher race-hardened import: Naturalism win, Turnbull (heavy, failed), Caulfield Cup 6th as second favourite.
runners.verdict: Caulfield Cup sixth as second favourite; light weight, good gate, but wet ground is against him.

silks.desc: Navy, white spots, cream armbands, white and navy cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Four straight wins, the latest the Bendigo Cup six days out - the same Bendigo Cup backup Knight's Choice used in 2024, and a Prince Of Penzance-style hardened local. Rising sharply in class; on-pace type who will be in the first half.
runners.campaign: Baker hardened-local campaign: four straight wins through Sydney staying races then the Bendigo Cup six days out (Knight's Choice 2024 backup), ridden on speed.
runners.verdict: Four straight wins, Bendigo Cup six days out like Knight's Choice 2024, wet-track stats 16: 4-5-2. Big class rise.

silks.desc: Green, white stripes, green and yellow checked sleeves, yellow cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: 15th in the 2023 Cup for Maher. Got in after late scratchings. Jamie Melham (2025 winning rider) aboard.
runners.campaign: Hickman race-hardened: JRA Plate 2nd, Herbert Power 4th, MV Cup 9th.
runners.verdict: Late inclusion, nine-year-old, 15th in 2023. Pass.

silks.desc: Red and yellow diagonal stripes, royal blue sleeves, red cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Epsom Derby third, gelded since; lightly raced (7 starts) classic-generation import on 53.5kg - the Rekindling / Cross Counter profile, and from the Rekindling stable. Untried beyond 2420m, drawn 24 (widest).
runners.campaign: O'Brien Rekindling-style fly-in: classic-generation 4yo, Epsom Derby 3rd, gelded, mid-summer break, one prep run (Kilternan), straight on the plane, 52 days fresh.
runners.verdict: Rekindling profile from the Rekindling stable: Derby third, gelded, 53.5kg. Gate 24 and untried past 2420m.

silks.desc: Navy, white spots, cream armbands, navy and white cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Proven marathon stayer (beat Defiantly over 4013m at Royal Ascot) but raced on speed and weakened in a slowly run MV Cup. Promoted after Defiantly's scratching.
runners.campaign: O'Brien with an Australian run (unusual for him): MV Gold Cup attempt at a Golden Ticket, raced on speed and weakened, ten days to the Cup.
runners.verdict: Proven marathon stayer who weakened in a slow MV Cup. Each-way roughie only on a strongly run race.

silks.desc: White, pink star, white cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Favourite. Bought from King Charles in August; only his sixth start. Sustained on-pace Geelong Cup win (rivals off the bit from the 600m) earned a 2kg penalty to 53kg. Trying to be the first Geelong Cup -> Melbourne Cup double since Dunaden (2011). Lightly raced 4yo on a light weight is also the Rekindling / Cross Counter age-weight profile.
runners.campaign: Handled like a European fly-in despite the Maher stable: UK base (Queen's Vase 4th, Bahrain Trophy win), first shipment to Werribee quarantine, ONE Australian run (Geelong Cup win) 13 days out - Americain / Dunaden / Media Puzzle shape, not Maher's usual 3-5 run build.
runners.verdict: Favourite. Trained from Werribee quarantine with one sustained on-pace Geelong Cup win, only six starts, 53kg. Americain / Dunaden shape.

silks.desc: Royal blue, light blue diagonal stripes, light blue cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: SA Derby runner-up (short head) in May; last in the MV Gold Cup.
runners.campaign: Carberry: SA Derby 2nd in autumn, MV Gold Cup last.
runners.verdict: Last in the MV Cup. No.

silks.desc: Navy, three yellow spots, navy cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Bart Cummings winner on a rain-affected Flemington (the Almandin 2016 ticket), then third carrying 57.5kg in the MV Cup after racing wide, over-racing and his apprentice dropping the whip. Drops to 52.5kg. Apprentice Jabez Johnstone's first Cup ride.
runners.campaign: Maher Golden Ticket campaign: Bart Cummings win on rain-affected Flemington (Almandin 2016 ticket) then MV Gold Cup 3rd under 57.5kg ten days out; forward type.
runners.verdict: Bart Cummings winner on a heavy Flemington, unlucky MV Cup third under 57.5kg, drops to 52.5kg. The wet-track value.

silks.desc: Red, navy logo, white armbands, red cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Andrew Ramsden (2800m) winner in May - the Golden Ticket route that has produced placings but no winner. Mile run was a deliberate warm-up. Begg's first Cup runner; William Pike.
runners.campaign: Begg Golden Ticket campaign: Andrew Ramsden win in May, break, Naturalism / Herbert Power build, Crystal Mile sharpener ten days out.
runners.verdict: Andrew Ramsden ticket, odd mile sharpener. Pike rides; needs luck from the back.

silks.desc: Light blue, green hoops, light blue sleeves, green cap
silks.source: ABC Melbourne Cup sweep grid (user supplied screenshot)

runners.notes: Daughter of Shocking (2009 winner, also 51kg). Archer Stakes winner, good closing sectionals when sixth in the Herbert Power, then an eye-catching second over 2040m. Bottom weight, never beyond 2500m, mare; Coffey riding with a sore shoulder.
runners.campaign: Maher Golden Ticket campaign: Archer Stakes win in September, Herbert Power, Tesio Stakes (2040m) sharpener ten days out; ridden last.
runners.verdict: Bottom weight, daughter of Shocking, closing well in slow races. Never past 2500m and a mare.

silks.desc: Navy, orange checked sash, navy sleeves, orange and black checked cap
